sentences.text: Researchers constructed a spin-wave-based artificial neuron that fires and resets after receiving a signal, utilizing a garnet magnetic material and a micro-antenna to generate its response.
To monitor the fading of the device's memory, the team employed a light-based measurement technique.
The system demonstrated the capacity to accumulate signals from up to 50 distinct pulses over a period of time.
Additionally, the study indicated that three such units could be connected in a sequence where one initiates the next.
